query: INSERT INTO access_tokens(name,audience,token_hash,expires_at,oauth_grant,tenant_id,workspace_id,resource,admin) SELECT $1,$2,$3,LEAST(now()+interval '1 hour',g.expires_at),g.id,e.tenant_id,e.id,'/mcp',g.admin FROM oauth_grants g JOIN endpoints e ON e.id=g.endpoint_id WHERE g.id=$4 RETURNING extract(epoch FROM expires_at-now())::bigint AS "seconds!"
